title: Warmth while the familiar passes
meaning: Your tenderness can accompany the end of a familiar stage when joy leaves room for regret.
text: Even a welcome change can have a sad edge. In the physical position of Anahata, the Empress expresses involvement through things that warm the day: food, comfort and small prepared attentions. The Sun in energy brings a wish to share pleasure openly and see each other without excessive guessing. Death in emotions describes experiencing an ending. You can welcome something new while feeling that a familiar part of life really has finished. Tenderness gains a particular meaning when it does not require you to choose one correct mood between you.

Suppose you clear a room for a shared plan you have wanted for a long time. The old desk goes, boxes are packed, and you arrange a small celebratory lunch on the floor. **Joy can remain shared even when saying goodbye feels different for each of you.** You want to make plans and remember earlier evenings in the room. Support means being free to do both: enjoying the new space together need not require the past to be declared unnecessary.

The difficulty is hearing sadness as a refusal to share your pleasure. You argue for the benefits of the change and hurry to remove the remaining reminders. The person who feels sad becomes alone with that feeling although care continues nearby. Warmth lasts when an ending can have weight without a debate about who is responding more correctly to the shared good news.
